title: Harvard University Distinguished Service Professor Saris Professor of Education and Economics
bio: Bridget Long is an economist who focuses on the transition from high school to higher education and beyond, examining the impact of affordability and academic preparation on student outcomes.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
